BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning obtaining required clinical experience for licensed practical nurses who complete a nontraditional registered nurse program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to obtaining required clinical experience for licensed practical nurses who complete a nontraditional registered nurse program; and repealing RCW 18.79.380.

BillSectionHeader.P: RCW 18.79.380 (Licensed practical nurse/nontraditional registered nurse program—Obtaining required clinical experience) and 2004 c 262 s 7 are each repealed.
